title: Gavel corpus labels
description: Labeled samples for heuristic precision measurement under fixtures/corpus/<tag>/labels.json. Internal corpus tooling format (not a public irreversible interface); public precision contract is corpus-precision-report.schema.json.

schemaVersion.description: Corpus labels format version. Bump only with a documented migration.

tag.description: Self-check / review rule id this corpus measures (must match directory name).

language.description: Programming language id (ts, js, py, java, …).

framework.description: Test framework id (playwright, cypress, selenium, pytest, …).

rationale.description: One-line reason this sample is labeled violating or clean.

expectedFindings.description: Required for violating samples; must be empty or omitted for clean.

subCase.description: Optional field lock: the finding must carry this subCase value.

replaceable.description: Optional field lock: the finding must carry this replaceable value.

pollingLoop.description: Optional field lock: the finding must carry pollingLoop=true.

suggestion.description: Optional field lock: the finding must carry this suggestion value.
